name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
how_to_apply: Register at pmkisan.gov.in or through CSC/local agriculture office

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefit: Crop insurance at 2% premium (kharif), 1.5% (rabi), 5% (horticulture). Govt pays remaining premium.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
how_to_apply: Through bank (loan farmers auto-enrolled) or CSC portal

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop
benefit: 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers, 45% for others on micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler)
eligibility: All farmers; higher subsidy for SC/ST/small/marginal

name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Pump Scheme)
benefit: 60% subsidy (30% central + 30% state) on solar pumps up to 7.5 HP
eligibility: All farmers with grid-connected or off-grid pump needs
how_to_apply: Apply through state DISCOM or agriculture department portal

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
benefit: 40-50% subsidy on farm machinery (tractors excluded); Custom Hiring Centres promoted

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free soil testing and nutrient recommendations every 2 years
how_to_apply: Visit nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture office

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
benefit: Subsidized seeds, micronutrients, demonstrations, and equipment for rice/wheat/pulses/coarse cereals
eligibility: Farmers in identified districts growing target crops

name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
benefit: Subsidy on planting material, drip, shade nets, cold storage, pack houses for horticulture crops
eligibility: Farmers growing fruits, vegetables, flowers, spices, plantation crops

name: MGNREGA - Farm-related Works
benefit: 100 days guaranteed wage employment; farm ponds, land leveling, plantation work covered
how_to_apply: Apply to Gram Panchayat with job card

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
benefit: 3% interest subvention on loans up to ₹2 crore for post-harvest infrastructure (cold storage, warehouses, sorting)

name: Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran Pariyojana (MKSP)
benefit: Training, resources, and support for women in agriculture; organic farming promotion
how_to_apply: Through state rural livelihood missions / NRLM

name: Interest Subvention on KCC Crop Loans
benefit: 2% interest subvention + 3% prompt repayment incentive → effective 4% on crop loans up to ₹3 lakh
how_to_apply: Automatically applied to eligible KCC accounts
